name: Discord In-Game Controller
description: Control Discord from inside Minecraft. Send DMs with /dmsg, answer calls, and fire under-attack / help alerts that carry your coordinates, dimension and server IP. Link teammates' Discord to their Minecraft accounts so their alerts reach you in-game with a one-click join button. Your Discord token is read locally from the Discord desktop app, encrypted with a master password, and only ever sent to Discord's own API.
